_about: Researched profile (web sources listed), compiled 2026-11-07. Shipped with Headroom.
name: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 Ti

profile.board: MSI (PCI subsystem 1462:5310). 300 W default = 300 W max, so this is a locked-power MSI model (Ventus 3X OC, Ventus 3X PZ OC or Shadow 3X OC all ship like this); check the box/sticker for the exact SKU.
profile.chip: GB203-300 Blackwell, 8,960 CUDA cores, 16 GB GDDR7 28 Gbps, 256-bit (896 GB/s)
profile.tuning_method: Core + memory clock offsets via NVML (no voltage change; power stays capped at 300 W by the card's firmware). Optional 'efficiency mode' clock cap = undervolt-like result.

community_results.settings: +420 core, memory slider maxed, power not adjustable
community_results.result: ~3,150 MHz real clock; +12% Cyberpunk 2077, +7% Plague Tale Requiem, +9% Hellblade 2; power unchanged
39 Gbps (+40% bandwidth) but only ~1 fps per +1000 MHz in Cyberpunk: memory OC past +3000 is not worth it
Ventus base model OC is held back by the hard 300 W power limit

notes: Offsets don't raise voltage or power: the 300 W cap is enforced by the card, so an overclock here can crash a game but cannot cook the GPU.
GDDR7 corrects errors by retrying, so a too-high memory offset shows up as LOST performance before it crashes. Headroom stops when bandwidth drops.
